name: Hotel Costanero Montevideo - Mgallery
insider_take: This sophisticated MGallery gem sits perfectly positioned along Montevideo's scenic Rambla waterfront, where European elegance meets South American soul in Uruguay's captivating capital.
whats_special: Hotel Costanero Montevideo occupies a prime location along the famous Rambla Sur, the world's longest continuous sidewalk that stretches for 22 kilometers along Montevideo's coastline. The hotel showcases MGallery's signature blend of local culture and refined hospitality, with stunning views of the Rio de la Plata. Montevideo's unique position makes it the only capital city where you can watch both sunrise and sunset over water.
pro_tip: Book a room facing the Rambla for breathtaking sunset views, and time your stay during December-March when locals flock to the nearby Pocitos Beach for summer festivities.
dont_miss: Stroll the historic Ciudad Vieja (Old City) just minutes away, featuring colonial architecture and the iconic Mercado del Puerto. The nearby Teatro Solís, one of South America's oldest theaters, and the vibrant Saturday markets at Tristán Narvaja offer authentic Montevidean experiences. The hotel's proximity to both cultural landmarks and the Rambla's jogging and cycling paths makes it ideal for exploring this UNESCO City of Literature.
pros: Prime waterfront location with stunning Rio de la Plata views
Boutique MGallery property with distinctive local character
Strategic location near Montevideo's main attractions
cons: Limited dining options within the hotel
Boutique size means fewer on-site facilities
